fssai_veg_logo.title: Vegetarian Logo Declaration
fssai_veg_logo.authority: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations
fssai_veg_logo.explanation: Packaged food must display the standardized green circle inside a green square border indicating vegetarian status.
fssai_veg_logo.question: Is the vegetarian logo displayed with the statutory minimum 3mm diameter circle on the Principal Display Panel?

mrp_declaration.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
mrp_declaration.explanation: Must state 'MRP Rs. / ₹ ... (inclusive of all taxes)' in conspicuous, unambiguous lettering.
mrp_declaration.question: Does the retail price declaration include statutory tax inclusion wording?

fssai_licence_number.title: FSSAI 14-Digit Licence Number
fssai_licence_number.authority: FSSAI (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations
fssai_licence_number.explanation: The 14-digit FSSAI licence number must accompany the FSSAI logo on the package.
fssai_licence_number.question: Does the package display a valid 14-digit FSSAI registration/licence number matching company registry?

metric_net_quantity.title: Metric Net Quantity Declaration
metric_net_quantity.explanation: Net weight or volume must be declared in standard metric units (g, kg, mL, L) with minimum numeral height.
metric_net_quantity.question: Is the net quantity declared using standard SI metric units with compliant minimum font height?

consumer_care_details.title: Consumer Care & Grievance Contact
consumer_care_details.explanation: Must provide name, address, telephone number, and email address of person/office to contact for consumer complaints.
consumer_care_details.question: Are telephone, email, and postal address clearly designated for customer grievance redressal?

unit_sale_price.title: Unit Sale Price (USP)
unit_sale_price.explanation: Packages containing more than 1 kg/L must declare unit sale price per gram/millilitre.
unit_sale_price.question: Is unit sale price calculated and formatted according to statutory rules?

date_of_manufacture.title: Date of Manufacture / Best Before
date_of_manufacture.explanation: Must declare date of manufacture or packaging along with 'Best Before' or expiry timeframe.
date_of_manufacture.question: Are manufacturing date and shelf-life period formatted without ambiguous truncation?

allergen_declaration.title: Allergen Declaration
allergen_declaration.authority: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations
allergen_declaration.explanation: Must declare common allergens present or potential cross-contamination warnings.
allergen_declaration.question: Are all major food allergens identified in bold type or under a dedicated Contains header?

notices.bilingualExplanation: UI localization is provided for reviewer convenience. Regulatory requirements derive from statutory gazette notifications.
notices.dualLanguageRegulatoryNote: Under FSSAI Rule 2.1.1, declarations on packaged food shall be in English or Hindi (Devanagari script), unless another official state language is explicitly designated.
notices.aiSuggestedNote: Extracted competitor packaging elements are AI-suggested visual readings and do not constitute legal compliance clearance.
